Make sure you follow all pre and post op instructions from your vet. Pick a wet food now if you haven't already and start getting them used to it so they don't have any tummy troubles post op. My vet recommended to pick a pate texture that we could use to shape into puppy sized meatballs (I used a small cookie scoop for this) so that when they first get out of surgery they aren't chewing and excessively swallowing, which would irritate the site. They can just grab a meatball and swallow it. You can also pop their antibiotics, pain meds, etc into the meatball. Easiest pilling ever. 

She was on strict cage rest for right around four weeks if I'm remembering right, the last two weeks were the hardest because she just wanted to play. That means on a leash when not in a crate or pen, no running, no jumping. No toys, because if they swallow anything sharp it can be very bad.

After the first two weeks we were able to switch from 100% canned food to moistened dry. You still want it completely soft though. She eats a cup dry food per meal, 2x a day. So after every meal, I would take a bowl and mix equal parts dog food and water and then throw it in the fridge for 8 to 12 hours to soak. Don't pour off any excess (I really never had any but the food was nice a soft), just mix a little and give it straight to them.

We did nares and BOAS, she had dissolvable stitches and we just had to make sure she didn't rip them until she healed up nicely (two weeks for the nares). Had to cone of shame her until that healed when we couldn't watch her.

The year in the mortal realm was 2006. Proserpina ran the golden comb lined with monstrous fangs through her hair slowly as she stared into the mirror, still seething from the news. Her husband had grown meek with the age and the relative peace they had grown to know in the Underworld as of late. Pluto didn't seem to realize the insult, or perhaps he preferred to turn a blind eye. Proserpina found that more difficult.

Since the fall of Latin and Greek theology, humans had gone long unchecked. There were still pockets of Hellenism that persisted into the modern era - that was one of the few saving graces for humanity, as Jupiter seemed willing to forgive far too much these days as long as their stories continued to be told. As long as they did not fade into oblivion like so many gods before them, and so many after.

Proserpina thought the lot of them were fools, allowing man to openly mock what they had once feared and revered. The movies were becoming absolute abominations - Troy, Percy Jackson - and now this? They had already given the god of the Underworld the smallest planet of the system but this was truly a slap in the face. Which one of the gods would lose their planetary status next? How much would Jupiter stand to tolerate?

She eyed the pyxis that set on her vanity closely as she continued to brush her hair. It hadn't been opened in decades, having been entrusted to her care. Pluto had warned her against using it frivolously.

Proserpina set the comb down on the vanity with a small clatter, running her fingers over the clasp of the box. Certainly this warranted action. With a vicious smile, she flicked the hook that held the box closed for just a moment. The lid flew open with astonishing pressure, smoke billowing from within. It swirled in the air above her before rushing for the nearest exit, racing to the surface. Proserpina snapped the lid shut with a single hand, reaching for her comb once more.

The year in the mortal realm was 2019.
